title: Product basis for a tensor product of finite free modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $M$ and $N$ be free $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with finite bases $(m_i)_{i\in I}$ and $(n_j)_{j\in J}$. Then the tensors $m_i\otimes_R n_j$ in the tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], indexed by $I\times J$, form an $R$-basis of $M\otimes_R N$.
